decisions_requested.statement: Approve KALA -> PERSONAL_NAME_DOMAIN and AN -> FIRST_PERSON_REFERENT as new governed standalone CANDIDATE mappings derived from observed phrase evidence, without historical standalone-gloss claims.

Approve EN -> SECOND_PERSON_REFERENT, KU -> CONTENT_SELECTOR and KE -> QUESTION_OPERATOR as new governed standalone CANDIDATE functional mappings for scoped L01 use, without declaring universal historical pronoun/interrogative grammar.
Approve ZAMI -> SPEAK_LANGUAGE_USE as a new governed standalone CANDIDATE mapping from repeated recovered phrase evidence, without claiming a historically recovered standalone lexical gloss.
Approve VANI -> RESIDENCE_LIVE only as a scoped L01 semantic binding on recovered LEX-031, keeping master meaning null and WATCH authority unchanged.
Approve VAME -> PREFERENCE_LIKE as an L01 curriculum rebind of recovered LEX-025, preserving GATE authority, existing recovered provenance and no global preference grammar.

Confirm all six proposed new authored entries must enter @hnk/linguas/authored as CANDIDATE with historicalRecoveryClaim=false, and VANI/VAME must not be duplicated there because they already exist in the recovered Master Lexicon.

Confirm approval of this exact mapping would authorize a subsequent application step that registers AUTH-015..020, records VANI/VAME scoped bindings and authors VOC-025..032; it does not validate those eight Vocabulary slots automatically.

application_rule: Do not edit @hnk/linguas/authored, bind VANI/VAME to the final Vocabulary slots, or change VOC-025..032 from MISSING until all seven mapping decisions are explicitly approved.
